description: One save request. Document is a deep copy (snapshot) taken at request time, so the host may serialize or persist it asynchronously while the user keeps editing; Revision is the editor's monotonic document revision the snapshot was taken at.

members.name: CancellationToken
members.description: Cancelled when the editor is disposed, so the host can abandon its own I/O. Pass it to your store/HTTP calls instead of ignoring it.

members.name: Revision
members.description: The editor revision the snapshot was taken at.
